383:t_1:3.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

383:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's already been two weeks since we crossed to the Central Continent.」

383:t_1:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Victory after victory... We've managed to hit $$サイデリアル$$'s forces reasonably hard.」

383:t_1:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I thought $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ would keep dogging us, but he's been surprisingly quiet.」

383:t_1:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That man has been failing one time after another, too. He may have been relieved of his post.」

383:t_1:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In that case, the ones who'll come out are $$サルディアス$$... and then $$バルビエル$$.」

383:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ comes out, we'll have to be prepared for the matter of Miss $$スズネ$$ as well.」

383:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「He's a despicable man... Who knows what kind of method he'll come at us with...」

383:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「There's no point in fearing uncertain factors. Let's concentrate on the fighting on the Central Continent.」

383:t_1:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the north of this continent has already fallen to $$ランド$$ and the others.」

383:t_1:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「From here, we strike the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s in each region and take down the $$セントラル・ベース$$ that governs the south, and $$サイデリアル$$ will have no choice but to withdraw.」

383:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Of those, the base we're targeting next is large in scale and will carry great significance in the battles ahead.」

383:t_1:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「A $$ターミナル・ベース$$ inside a city... It has a layout similar to $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$...」

383:t_1:16.en:
$$ブライト$$
「This operation will be a joint operation with a local Resistance group.」

383:t_1:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「It will affect the morale of the entire Central Continent. We must make it a success without fail.」

383:t_1:22.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「It's been a while, $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

383:t_1:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Good to see everyone on your side looking well, too.」

383:t_1:24.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Who'd have thought you guys were members of the $c we keep hearing rumors about.」

383:t_1:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm happy to be able to fight alongside all of you again.」

383:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll take down the $$ターミナル・ベース$$'s main force. I'm counting on you guys to guide the residents to evacuation.」

383:t_1:27.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Leave it to us. It'll be a huge help if you take the front line.」

383:t_1:28.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「After all, that base is practically holding the whole city hostage.」

383:t_1:29.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now that we're here, you can rest easy and leave it all to us!」

383:t_1:30.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「There it is, the Heat Smile!」

383:t_1:31.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Oh, that reminds me... We're holding a message addressed to you.」

383:t_1:34.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Nope, it's from a man. The leader of a Resistance group way up north of here.」

383:t_1:35.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Known as $$ブラック・サザンクロス$$... Have you heard of him?」

383:t_1:37.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Aren't you going to talk with the Resistance people, $n?」

383:t_1:38.en:
$n
「No... They're acquaintances of $$セツコ$$ and the others, but it's my first time meeting them.」

383:t_1:39.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I see... I thought $n was in the same group as that hothead over there, the hard-luck beauty, and the guy buried in debt.」

383:t_1:41.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh, but... you're a little different, $n.」

383:t_1:42.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Because you're special to me, $n.」

383:t_1:48.en:
$n
(I guess I'd better not ask about family after all... Everyone has their own circumstances...)

383:t_1:49.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Starting a conversation yourself and then leaving me hanging like that... I don't like it.」

383:t_1:51.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I'll ask you something hard to answer instead.」

383:t_1:53.en:
$n
「She's my partner. She was also my teacher back when I went to school, so that's what I call her.」

383:t_1:54.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's not what I want to hear. I'm asking what kind of relationship she and you have, $n.」

383:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Relationship...? We're partners when we fight, and teacher and student the rest of the time, but...」

383:t_1:56.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't want to hear that kind of evasion.」

383:t_1:58.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$甲児$$ and $$カレン$$ and $$クルツ$$ and $$マオ$$ all tell me to ask the person directly for anything more than that...」

383:t_1:61.en:
$n
「...It's not like that. Besides, there was someone else who was that to me.」

383:t_1:62.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Where is that person now?」

383:t_1:64.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't tell me it just fizzled out on its own?」

383:t_1:66.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then maybe I'll... throw my hat in the ring, to be $n's girlfriend.」

383:t_1:68.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't be so shocked. ...Wouldn't it be fun if that happened?」

383:t_1:69.en:
$n
「...Sorry... This isn't a situation where I can think about things like that right now.」

383:t_1:71.en:
$n
「It's not that. ...Your cheerfulness has helped me, and I'm grateful too.」

383:t_1:72.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You really can't forget about this Miss $$スズネ$$, can you...?」

383:t_1:73.en:
$n
「There's nothing to forget. Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't dead. I'll rescue her, no matter what.」

383:t_1:76.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Um, $n... If I die, set me adrift in space...」

383:t_1:77.en:
$n
「What are you saying, all of a sudden...!?」

383:t_1:78.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's not sudden, is it? Not in times like these.」

383:t_1:79.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... always think about it. About what happens after I die.」

383:t_1:81.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's a promise, $n. You turned me down, so you can at least grant me that much of a request.」

383:t_1:83.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh... I don't need any comforting, okay? That bid before was just something I tried saying, and I wasn't serious in the least.」

383:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do your best, $n. I'll be cheering you on to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」

ブラック・サザンクロス.evidence: Alias of a northern Resistance group leader (male), in dlg_2052_00 row 383:t_1:35; not in glossary sheet.

kept_omissions: 383:t_1:48: whose family Hibiki decides not to ask about is left open (Titi's, presumably; the Japanese does not say).
383:t_1:58: 本人 (the person themselves) kept as 'the person' - could be Hibiki or Suzune; scene doesn't settle.
